events.name: Pittsburgh Penguins at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Max Domi scored the winner with 8:25 remaining to snap a 23-game goalless streak and added an assist to end the Toronto Maple Leafs’ three-game slide with a 6-3 win against the Pittsburgh Penguins on Tuesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: William Nylander's 4-points lift Maple Leafs over Penguins 6-3, snapping 3-game skid

events.name: Dallas Stars at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Dylan Larkin scored the tying goal late in the third period and then got the winner 34 seconds into overtime to rally Detroit Red Wings to a 4-3 victory over the Dallas Stars on Tuesday night for their third straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Larkin gets tying goal late in 3rd and winner in OT as Red Wings beat Stars 4-3 for 3rd straight win

events.name: New York Rangers at Washington Capitals

headlines.description: — Taylor Raddysh and Alexis Lafreniere scored 68 seconds apart, part of a five-goal third period for the New York Rangers in a 7-3 victory over the Washington Capitals on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rangers score 5 goals in the 3rd period to beat the Capitals 7-3 for another road win

headlines.description: — Zachary Bolduc scored to give the Canadiens the lead as Montreal scored four goals in a five-minute span to snap a third-period tie and run away from the Boston Bruins 6-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Canadiens score 4 in the 3rd period to turn fight-filled game against rival Bruins into a laugher

headlines.description: — Bowen Byram scored his second goal of the game 31 seconds into overtime and the Buffalo Sabres beat the Ottawa Senators 3-2 on Tuesday night, extending their win streak to seven heading into the Christmas break.
headlines.shortLinkText: Byram lifts Sabres over Senators 3-2 in OT for first 7-game win streak in 7 years

events.name: New Jersey Devils at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Adam Pelech scored the tiebreaking goal late in the third period, and the New York Islanders beat the New Jersey Devils 2-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pelech scores late in 3rd period as Islanders beat Devils 2-1

headlines.description: — Luke Kunin and Anton Lundell scored 43 seconds apart during a five-goal third period for the Florida Panthers, who rallied past the Carolina Hurricanes 5-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kunin and Lundell score during Panthers' 5-goal 3rd period in 5-2 win over Hurricanes

headlines.description: — Steven Stamkos scored 53 seconds into overtime to give the Nashville Predators a 3-2 victory over the Minnesota Wild on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steven Stamkos scores in OT to give the Predators a 3-2 win over the Wild

headlines.description: — Travis Konecny scored and added his 300th career assist, leading the Philadelphia Flyers past the Blackhawks 3-1 on Tuesday night and handing depleted Chicago its sixth straight loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Konecny has goal and assist to lead Flyers past Blackhawks 3-1, handing Chicago 6th straight loss

headlines.description: — Scott Wedgewood made 32 saves for his second shutout of the season, and the NHL-best Colorado Avalanche beat the Utah Mammoth 1-0 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Scott Wedgewood makes 32 saves and Avalanche beat Mammoth 1-0 for 6th straight win

headlines.description: — Connor McDavid had five assists, Leon Draisaitl scored three goals and the Edmonton Oilers kept rolling into the holiday hiatus with a 5-1 victory over the rival Calgary Flames on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: McDavid has 5 assists and Draisaitl scores 3 goals as the surging Oilers defeat the Flames 5-1

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Vegas Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Mitch Marner scored two goals, Reilly Smith had a goal and an assist, and the Vegas Golden Knights tied a franchise record with five goals in the first period and beat the San Jose Sharks 7-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Marner scores 2 as Golden Knights get 5 in 1st period and beat Sharks 7-2

events.name: Seattle Kraken at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Jordan Eberle had a power-play goal, Frederick Gaudreau and Ben Meyers also scored, and the Seattle Kraken held on for a 3-2 win over the Los Angeles Kings on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jordan Eberle scores on the power play and Kraken hold off struggling Kings 3-2
